title: Measurable embedding into the torus
statement: For each $n\ge0$, map $x\in\mathbb R^n$ to the torus with coordinates indexed by $(j,b)\in\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\}$, whose $(j,0)$ coordinate is $x_j$ modulo $\mathbb Z$ and whose $(j,1)$ coordinate is $\sqrt2 x_j$ modulo $\mathbb Z$. This map is a measurable embedding.
